download_algonauts_dataset: create a Datalad instance with a dataset directory and call download to fetch the Algonauts 2025 dataset
install_datalad_requirements: call Datalad.install_requirements to install datalad and git-annex via the datalad-installer tool
check_download_success: call get_success_file on a Datalad instance to get the path of the success marker file
configure_wildcard_folders: create a Wildcard model with a folder glob pattern to match all subdirectories during download
run_datalad_command: call the private _datalad method to execute a datalad shell command in a given path
